message: Health & Safety Instruction: 12 sections in 4 chapters
Client Service Level Agreement: 9 sections in 3 chapters
Hall, yard and zones overview (389 words)
F-ZON-16 | rework_area.location = zone_f | The rework area is located in Zone F.

F-RSP-09 | floor_staff.reassignment_authority = shift_supervisor | Floor staff must stay in assigned zones and tasks unless reassigned by the shift supervisor.; F-RSP-10 | overtime_period.supervision_cover = supervisor | Every approved overtime period must be covered by a responsible supervisor.; F-RUL-04 | building.out_of_hours_access = closed unless overtime approved and supervised | Outside staffed shifts the building remains closed unless overtime working has been expressly approved and supervised.
General floor rules and PPE (449 words)
Procedure system PR-01 to PR-15 (538 words)
Carrier arrival and dock assignment (384 words)
F-RSP-11 | inbound_exception.notification_recipient = shift_supervisor | The shift supervisor must be notified immediately of inbound quantity variances, damage or missing documents.
Booking and release to put-away (330 words)

F-ZON-17 | pallet_labelling.location = Zone A | Pallet labels are printed or activated at booking in Zone A and each pallet carries its identifier before leaving Zone A.; F-ZON-18 | inbound_staging.location = Zone A | Booked inbound pallets are staged in Zone A by destination before put-away collection.
Bulk storage in Zone B (438 words)

F-LIM-16 | rack_position.max_pallet_identifiers = 1 pallets | Each rack position in Zone B may hold only one pallet identifier.; F-ORD-10 | putaway.confirmation_order = scan confirmation before leaving bay | Rack put-away booking must be confirmed with the WMS scanner before leaving the bay.; F-ZON-19 | overload_consignment.split_location = same aisle | A consignment that would overload a single rack bay must be split across two or more bays in the same aisle.; F-ZON-20 | free_block_stack.location = marked floor areas outside racking | Free block stacking in Zone B is only allowed in marked floor areas outside the racking and never inside storage aisles.; F-RSP-12 | bay_utilisation.monitoring_owner = stock_controller | Stock controllers are responsible for monitoring bay utilisation and reporting overloads or damage.; F-RSP-13 | unstable_stack.notification_recipient = shift_supervisor | Leaning stacks, broken boards or shifted loads must be reported to the shift supervisor.
Cold storage in Zone E (466 words)
Hazmat cage and quarantine in Zone F (370 words)

F-ZON-21 | hazmat_goods.storage_location = hazmat cage | All classified hazardous goods must be stored only inside the fenced hazmat cage.; F-ZON-22 | damaged_goods.storage_location = quarantine | Damaged units found during storage or returns inspection must be transferred to quarantine.; F-ORD-11 | quarantine.release_order = inspection, approval and system clearance, then release | Quarantine release happens only after inspection, approval and system clearance.

F-LIM-17 | pick_face.sku_limit = 1 SKU | Each pick face holds a single SKU facing the operator aisle.; F-ORD-12 | picking.confirmation_order = location scan, then unit scan | Each pick must scan the location label and then the unit label before placing goods into the order container.; F-ZON-23 | flow_lane.operation_sides = rear replenishment, front picking | Flow lanes are loaded from the rear replenishment side and picked from the front operator side.; F-ZON-24 | empty_pallets_waste.staging_location = marked collection points | Empty pallets and waste in Zone C must be staged only at the marked collection points.

F-RSP-14 | replenishment.trigger_owner = stock_controller | Stock controllers trigger replenishment from inventory accuracy data.; F-RSP-15 | replenishment_shortage.notification_recipient = shift_supervisor | Shortages, damage or misplaced reserve pallets during replenishment must be reported to the shift supervisor without delay.; F-ORD-13 | replenishment.scan_order = bulk pallet scan, then destination pick face scan | During replenishment the bulk pallet is scanned before the destination pick face is scanned.

F-ZON-25 | scanner.charging_location = charging station | Damaged, low-battery, unreadable-display and end-of-shift handheld WMS scanners must be returned to and stored in the charging station/charger.

F-ORD-14 | packing.dispatch_order = Packing and labelling, then Outbound dispatch | Packing and labelling (PR-05) must be executed for every order container before release to outbound dispatch (PR-06).; F-ORD-15 | wrapping.staging_order = Wrap, then stage | Every outbound pallet must be wrapped to base-to-top stability before staging for collection.
Dispatch staging in Zone D (315 words)
Load release and truck loading (379 words)

F-ORD-16 | dock_restraint.placement_order = place restraint or wheel chock, then open trailer doors | The dock restraint or wheel chock must be placed before opening the trailer doors.; F-ORD-17 | trailer_loading.inspection_order = inspect trailer condition, then start loading | Trailer condition must be checked before loading starts.; F-ORD-18 | trailer_departure.reconciliation_order = reconcile loaded quantity, then close doors | Loaded quantity must be reconciled with release documentation before closing the trailer doors.; F-RSP-16 | trailer_rejection.notification_recipient = dispatcher | Rejected contaminated, damaged or unsafe trailers must be notified to the dispatcher for replacement booking.
Pallet weight and trailer capacity (473 words)

F-ORD-19 | outbound_load.weight_check_order = assess before wrapping and staging, check at wrapping, verify at staging, re-confirm before departure | Outbound pallet weights must be assessed before wrapping and staging, checked at wrapping, verified at staging, and re-confirmed before truck departure.
Van and shift dispatch limit (371 words)

F-RSP-17 | door_out_of_service.notification_recipient = dispatcher | If an outbound door is taken out of service, the dispatcher must be notified immediately.; F-RSP-18 | labour_shortfall.notification_recipient = dispatcher | Any labour shortfall affecting outbound loading must be reported to the dispatcher immediately.

F-ORD-20 | cycle_count.comparison_order = physical_count_before_system_comparison | Cycle counts must count from physical stock first and then compare with the system figure.; F-RSP-19 | recount.assigned_counter = different_counter | Recounts for locations with a variance must be assigned to a different counter where staffing allows.; F-ORD-21 | counted_location.move_resumption_order = counter_release_before_resume | Moves for a location under active count may resume only after the counter releases the location.

F-ORD-22 | stocktake.move_freeze_order = freeze moves, then start counting | All inbound, outbound, replenishment and internal moves must be frozen before stocktake counting starts.; F-ORD-23 | stocktake.adjustment_posting_order = warehouse manager sign-off, then post adjustments | Approved wall-to-wall stock adjustments must be posted only after warehouse manager sign-off has been recorded.; F-ORD-24 | stocktake.operational_release_order = sign-off and posting, then resume normal work | The site may be released back to normal work only after stocktake sign-off and posting of all adjustments.
Racking care and stock accuracy (451 words)

F-ORD-25 | adjusted_location.reconfirmation_order = second physical check before task close | Any adjusted rack location must be reconfirmed by a second physical check before closing the task.; F-ORD-26 | out_of_service_bay.reuse_order = repair log confirmation before reuse | A bay marked out of service must not be reused until the repair log confirms its release.

F-ZON-26 | returns_receipt.location = Zone F | Returns receipt takes place in Zone F.; F-ORD-27 | returns_unloading.document_check_order = delivery note, return authorisation and reason before unloading | Delivery note, return authorisation and reason for return must be obtained before unloading returns.
Restock, rework or scrap decisions (353 words)

F-ZON-27 | restock.destination_zones = Zone B, Zone C, Zone E | Approved restock must be booked back to its Zone B, Zone C or Zone E location.; F-ORD-28 | rework.reinspection_order = re-inspection before restock booking | Approved rework units must return to inspection on completion before any restock booking.; F-ORD-29 | scrap_valuation.valuation_order = valuation before write-off approval | Every scrap and damaged-goods proposal must be valued in EUR at cost price before seeking write-off approval.

F-SCH-11 | damaged_goods.quarantine_transfer_deadline = same shift as discovery | Damaged units must be transferred to quarantine on the same shift they are discovered.; F-ORD-30 | quarantine_movement.system_entry_order = physical transfer, then system entry | Quarantine movement must be entered in the system immediately after the physical transfer.; F-ORD-31 | damaged_goods.photograph_order = photograph, then repacking or sorting | Damage must be photographed before any repacking or sorting.; F-ZON-28 | salvage_separation.location = Zone F | Separation of intact inner units from destroyed outer packaging must be done only inside Zone F.; F-SCH-12 | quarantine.review_frequency = each working day | Quarantine holdings must be reviewed each working day.
Aisles, walkways and speed limits (416 words)

F-ORD-32 | dock_equipment.inspection_order = inspect leveller, seal and restraint before positioning equipment | The leveller, dock seal and restraint must be inspected before positioning handling equipment at the door.; F-ORD-33 | outbound_pallet.containment_check_order = confirm containment before dock release | Film containment at base, corners and top layer must be confirmed before releasing a wrapped pallet to the dock.
F-RSP-20 | evacuation.in_charge = shift_supervisor | The on-duty shift supervisor is in charge of evacuation, controlling movement, accounting for staff and liaising with emergency services.

F-SCH-13 | incident_report.submission_deadline = before end of shift | Every incident report must be completed before the end of the shift in which the event occurred.; F-ORD-34 | rack_repair.unload_order = unload levels, then repair | Affected rack levels must be unloaded before any repair attempt.; F-ORD-35 | structural_damage.photograph_order = photograph, then move stock or repair | Structural rack damage must be photographed before moving stock or starting repairs.; F-RUL-05 | overloaded_bay.isolation_action = mark out of service immediately | Any overloaded rack bay must be marked out of service immediately until the load is corrected.

F-ZON-29 | chilled_pallets.staging_location = Zone E | Chilled pallets must not be staged outside Zone E except for immediate loading or put-away under active control.; F-ORD-36 | temperature_abuse_pallet.isolation_order = isolate and escalate before further movement | Any pallet showing temperature abuse must be isolated and escalated under PR-12 before any further movement.; F-ORD-37 | hazmat_cage.weight_check_order = check weight before put-away | Hazmat cage stock weight must be checked before every put-away and any receipt exceeding 4000 kg rejected.; F-SCH-14 | hazmat_cage.inspection_frequency = each shift | Hazmat cage containers, bunds, labels and extinguishers must be inspected each shift.; F-ZON-30 | incompatible_hazmat_classes.segregation_location = segregated within hazmat cage | Incompatible hazmat classes must be kept segregated within the hazmat cage.

F-SCH-15 | handover.frequency = every shift change | PR-15 end-of-shift handover must be executed at every change of shift without exception.; F-RSP-21 | handover.ownership = outgoing_shift_supervisor | The outgoing shift supervisor owns the handover and remains accountable until the incoming shift supervisor has accepted the floor in person.; F-RSP-22 | shift_log.sign_off = outgoing_shift_supervisor and incoming_shift_supervisor | Both the outgoing and incoming supervisors must sign the shift log handover entry to confirm transfer.; F-ORD-38 | handover.briefing_order = supervisor_exchange_then_staff_briefing | The supervisor-to-supervisor exchange must happen before briefing the incoming floor staff.; F-ORD-39 | outgoing_team.release_order = incoming_confirmation_then_release | The outgoing team may be released only after the incoming shift supervisor confirms readiness to assume control.
Speed limits and shared areas (378 words)
Walkways, aisles and dock areas (444 words)
Driver authorisation and truck checks (430 words)
Required PPE and seat belts (511 words)

F-RSP-23 | safety_event.notification_recipient = shift_supervisor | Any injury, near miss, racking or equipment damage, spill, fire alarm or unsafe behaviour must be notified to the shift supervisor immediately.

F-ORD-40 | hazmat_container.inspection_order = inspect before put-away | Hazmat containers must be inspected for leaks, damage and correct labelling before put-away.; F-RUL-06 | hazmat_container.label_orientation = outward | Hazmat container labels must face outward for identification during checks.; F-RUL-07 | hazmat_cage.stacking_prohibition = nothing against fencing, doors or safety equipment | Nothing may be stacked against hazmat cage fencing, doors or safety equipment.

F-ZON-31 | damaged_goods_assessment.location = quarantine area in Zone F | Damaged-goods inspection, sorting, repacking assessment, photography and valuation must be carried out only inside the quarantine area in Zone F.
F-ORD-41 | damaged_goods.write_off_approval_order = approval before system posting | Damaged-goods write-off approval must be obtained before posting any adjustment in the system.

F-SCH-16 | safety_review.frequency = weekly | Overdue safety follow-up actions are reviewed at a weekly safety review.; F-ZON-32 | drill_debrief.location = assembly point | Every evacuation drill is debriefed immediately at the assembly point.; F-RSP-24 | evacuation.reentry_authority = shift_supervisor | Only the on-duty shift supervisor may confirm the building is safe and release personnel to re-enter after an evacuation.
The canon states the dispatcher assigns dock doors and time slots, not the shift supervisor.
quote: door allocation and priority changes only from the shift supervisor

message: F-ZON-33 | putaway.transfer_route = Zone A to Zone B | Put-away moves transfer pallets from Zone A to Zone B.; F-ZON-34 | replenishment.transfer_route = bulk storage to Zone C | Replenishment moves transfer pallets from bulk storage to Zone C.
F-RSP-25 | picking_issues.notification_recipient = floor_lead | Picking scanner faults, damaged labels, empty locations and quantity variances must be reported to the floor lead immediately.

F-RSP-26 | packing.executed_by = packing_staff | Packing staff execute PR-05 packing and labelling for every order container before release toward dispatch.; F-ORD-42 | packing.bench_operation_order = verify by scan, select carton, pack, seal, label | Packing benches must operate in order: verify items by scan, then select carton, then pack, then seal, then apply labels.
F-ZON-35 | cycle_count.coverage_zones = Zone B, Zone C, Zone E, Zone F | Cycle counts are executed every working day covering Zone B, Zone C, Zone E and Zone F.

F-SCH-17 | repair_log.entry_deadline = same shift | Every maintenance intervention must be entered in the repair log on the same shift.; F-RSP-27 | defective_forklift.grounding_owner = maintenance_technician | The maintenance technician must ground any truck with a defective restraint.; F-RUL-08 | forklift.service_with_open_safety_defect = prohibited | No truck with an open safety defect may enter service.

F-RSP-28 | employee.reports_to = shift_supervisor | Each employee reports to the shift supervisor running the shift.; F-RSP-29 | shift_supervisor.reports_to = warehouse_manager | The shift supervisor reports to the warehouse manager.

F-ORD-43 | outbound_load.release_prerequisites = wrapping, documentation, dispatcher release | No outbound load may be released unless wrapping, documentation and dispatcher release are complete.; F-ORD-44 | staged_loads.release_order = door call order | Staged loads in Zone D are released in door call order.
Cycle Counts, Stocktake and Reporting (389 words)

F-RSP-30 | returns_logging.logged_by = administrators | Administrators log returns receipt, inspection findings and proposed disposition in the warehouse system.; F-SCH-18 | returns_logging.logging_deadline = day of inspection | Returns receipt, inspection findings and proposed disposition must be logged on the day of inspection.; F-RSP-31 | returns_confirmation.notification_recipient = client | The client receives confirmation of acceptance, inspection result and approved disposition for returns.; F-ORD-45 | returns_inventory_update.update_order = disposition approval, then system update | System inventory for returns is updated only after disposition approval.; F-SCH-19 | returns_inspection.inspection_deadline = same shift as receipt | Returns received must be inspected in the same shift and not left unexamined across shifts.; F-RUL-09 | returns_eligibility.measurement_endpoints = recorded delivery date to receipt of return request | Returns eligibility is measured from the recorded delivery date to receipt of the return request.
